description: Export one of the user's CVs as YAML text — a clean, structured copy for other tools or AI assistants. Free. Returns {yaml, filename}.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: export_takemeup_cv_yaml
title: Export CV as YAML (free)
